title: Units Released When an Outpatient Authorization Is Cancelled, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, when the patient, or the parent or guardian of a minor patient, confirms the cancellation of an approved authorization counted in visits, hours or rental months, it is closed as cancelled that day and the units left on it are released.

## Release

The units left are the units granted plus the units added by extensions, less the units used, all read from the authorization's unit history: the grant entries, the extension entries and the use entries. The release is every unit left, and is never fewer than zero.

## Worked example (hypothetical unit history of a Rehabilitative Therapy Referral)

| Entry | Visits |
|---|---|
| Grant on initial approval | 12 |
| Extension | 12 |
| Use entries, in total | 15 |

Units left: 12 plus 12, less 15, gives 9 visits; the cancellation releases 9 visits.

## Second example (hypothetical)

An Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization with a grant of 480 hours and 480 hours used has 0 hours left; the release is 0.
